scope: Read-only connected PostgreSQL metadata; two operational date pairs only
connection_discovery: Existing mcp__postgres__query connector; no credentials requested or .env read

schema_query.sql: SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND (table_name IN ('ohlcv', 'form4_transactions', 'earnings_surprise') OR table_name ILIKE '%identit%' OR table_name ILIKE '%security%' OR table_name ILIKE '%detect%' OR table_name ILIKE '%flag%') ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position

bar_count_query.sql: SELECT e.symbol, e.session_date, count(o.timestamp)::bigint AS bar_count FROM (VALUES ('NOC'::text, DATE '2025-02-21'), ('COST'::text, DATE '2026-04-02')) AS e(symbol, session_date) LEFT JOIN public.ohlcv AS o ON o.symbol = e.symbol AND o.venue = 'yfinance' AND o.interval = '1d' AND o.timestamp >= e.session_date::timestamp AND o.timestamp < e.session_date::timestamp + INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY e.symbol, e.session_date ORDER BY e.symbol, e.session_date

interpretation.database_access: AVAILABLE through connected read-only tool; earlier direct-process settings failure was not a global access failure
interpretation.operational_counts: One yfinance daily bar exists for each requested NOC/COST date pair. Counts only; no price or outcome fields selected.
interpretation.date_serialization: Returned date values are retained exactly as serialized by the connector; requested calendar dates are fixed in SQL.
interpretation.identity: UNVERIFIED; bare symbol/date counts do not establish historical security mapping
interpretation.detector: UNVERIFIED; no detector export was supplied or recomputed
interpretation.population: Two operational examples do not measure annual population coverage
